# langweave

<!-- generated by pack:skill — do not edit -->

Weaves a target language into the model's replies, at the level this user can actually read.

Connects to the hosted MCP server at `https://api.langweave.tech/mcp` and adds the `language-mode` skill.
You will be asked to sign in, and then to choose a target language at https://app.langweave.tech.

```
/plugin marketplace add Jesusdiazrivero/langweave-plugins
/plugin install langweave@langweave
```

- Documentation: https://docs.langweave.tech/connect/plugin/
- Privacy: https://langweave.tech/privacy
